```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from rlberry.envs.bandits import BernoulliBandit
from rlberry.agents.bandits import (
    UCBAgent,
    UCBVAgent,
    ETCAgent,
    MOSSAgent,
    IMEDAgent,
    NPTSAgent,
    EXP3Agent,
)
from rlberry.manager import ExperimentManager
from rlberry.wrappers import WriterWrapper
from rlberry.utils.writers import read_writer_data

# Problem parameters
n_arms = 5
arm_means = [0.1, 0.5, 0.7, 0.3, 0.9]
horizon = 5000
n_fit = 1  # Number of independent runs per agent

# Environment
env_ctor = BernoulliBandit
env_kwargs = dict(p=arm_means)

# Agent definitions
agent_classes = [
    ("UCB", UCBAgent, {}),
    ("UCBV", UCBVAgent, {}),
    ("ETC", ETCAgent, {"m": 100}),
    ("MOSS", MOSSAgent, {}),
    ("IMED", IMEDAgent, {}),
    ("NPTS", NPTSAgent, {"prior": "uniform"}),
    ("EXP3", EXP3Agent, {"gamma": 0.07}),
]

# Experiment managers
managers = []
for name, agent_class, agent_kwargs in agent_classes:
    def agent_ctor(env, agent_class=agent_class, agent_kwargs=agent_kwargs):
        agent = agent_class(env, **agent_kwargs)
        return WriterWrapper(agent)
    manager = ExperimentManager(
        agent_ctor,
        (env_ctor, env_kwargs),
        fit_budget=horizon,
        n_fit=n_fit,
        agent_name=name,
        output_dir=f"./results_bandit_{name}",
        parallelization="none",
        seed=123,
        enable_tensorboard=False,
    )
    managers.append(manager)

# Train agents
for manager in managers:
    manager.fit()

# Compute optimal mean and optimal arm
optimal_mean = np.max(arm_means)
optimal_arm = np.argmax(arm_means)

# Prepare for plotting
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 5))

# Colors and linestyles for agents
colors = sns.color_palette("tab10", len(agent_classes))
linestyles = ['-', '--', '-.', ':', (0, (3, 1, 1, 1)), (0, (5, 1)), (0, (1, 1))]

# Plot cumulative pseudo-regret
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
for idx, manager in enumerate(managers):
    data = read_writer_data(manager, tag="action")
    actions = np.array(data[0]["values"]).astype(int)
    pseudo_regret = np.cumsum(optimal_mean - np.array(arm_means)[actions])
    plt.plot(
        pseudo_regret,
        label=manager.agent_name,
        color=colors[idx],
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)],
        linewidth=2,
    )
plt.title("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret")
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Pseudo-Regret")
plt.legend()

# Plot cumulative regret (using actual rewards)
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
for idx, manager in enumerate(managers):
    data_action = read_writer_data(manager, tag="action")
    data_reward = read_writer_data(manager, tag="reward")
    actions = np.array(data_action[0]["values"]).astype(int)
    rewards = np.array(data_reward[0]["values"])
    optimal_rewards = np.random.binomial(1, optimal_mean, size=len(rewards))
    regret = np.cumsum(optimal_rewards - rewards)
    plt.plot(
        regret,
        label=manager.agent_name,
        color=colors[idx],
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)],
        linewidth=2,
    )
plt.title("Cumulative Regret")
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Regret")
plt.legend()

# Plot number of times each arm was selected
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
width = 0.1
x = np.arange(n_arms)
for idx, manager in enumerate(managers):
    data = read_writer_data(manager, tag="action")
    actions = np.array(data[0]["values"]).astype(int)
    counts = np.bincount(actions, minlength=n_arms)
    plt.bar(
        x + idx * width,
        counts,
        width=width,
        label=manager.agent_name,
        color=colors[idx],
        alpha=0.8,
    )
plt.title("Number of Times Each Arm Was Selected")
plt.xlabel("Arm")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.xticks(x + width * (len(agent_classes) - 1) / 2, [f"Arm {i}" for i in range(n_arms)])
plt.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
